_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY, from an unrelated imaginary ticket. Copy the SHAPE exactly: same keys, same nesting. surfaces are repo-relative file paths wherever the decision lives in a file; a short stable noun-phrase only for genuinely cross-cutting concerns. 3-8 decided entries is typical. least_confident refs point at decided ids. Do not add keys.

decided.claim: Parse the config with a hand-rolled line scanner instead of adding a TOML dependency; the file has four keys and the crate tree is dependency-averse.
Load config once at startup and pass it down; no global, no reload watcher.
A malformed config line warns and is skipped rather than aborting startup.

least_confident.why: Skipping bad lines silently accepts typos; aborting might be what this codebase's users expect.

not_done.why: Not asked for, and a watcher drags in a dependency.

not_done.claim: Behaviour under a config directory (rather than file) unverified.
not_done.why: Needs a running system to observe.
